description: This Java source file defines the class InputMethodSettingsImpl, which implements the InputMethodSettingsInterface. It manages input method settings in an Android application, including initialization, configuration of preferences, and handling subtypes for input methods such as keyboards.

classes.name: InputMethodSettingsImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing input method settings, including subtype enabler configuration and preference management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the input method settings, adds preferences, and returns whether the input method has multiple subtypes.

methods.name: getMyImi
methods.description: Retrieves the InputMethodInfo object for the current input method based on the context and input method manager.

methods.name: getEnabledSubtypesLabel
methods.description: Constructs a comma-separated string of the display names of enabled subtypes for the current input method.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the input method settings category (by resource ID).

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the input method settings category (by CharSequence).

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the subtype enabler (by resource ID).

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the subtype enabler (by CharSequence).

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon resource ID for the subtype enabler.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon drawable for the subtype enabler.

methods.name: getSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Returns the current title for the subtype enabler based on resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: updateSubtypeEnabler
methods.description: Updates the preference UI component with the latest title, icon, and summary based on current configuration and enabled subtypes.
